source: EPA NVFEL benchmark test-data package, workbook '4- 2016 Mazda 2.5L Turbo Skyactiv-G Engine Tier 3 Fuel - Test Data.xlsx' (package directory 2016-mazda-2-5-l-turbo-skyactiv-g-engine-tier-3-fuel-test-data-package-dated-03-13-19); public data, https://www.epa.gov/vehicle-and-fuel-emissions-testing/ (urls in out/epa_turbo_dl/urls.txt). Literal workbook readings rounded to 6 significant digits; nothing derived except the normalised cam signs, the two-bank lambda mean and the envelope / high_load flags.
selection: high_load = bmep_bar >= 0.5 * max(bmep_bar) = 11.5337 bar; envelope = highest torque among all rows of the 50-rpm speed bin

cam_convention.normalised: intake_cam_adv_deg positive = advanced; exhaust_cam_ret_deg positive = retarded
